diagnosis: The jwt_response_payload_handler fetches a CustomerBillingAccount by unvalidated query parameter account_id and embeds sensitive billing, tax identifier, and credit limit attributes into the login response without verifying that the authenticating user is the owner of that billing profile. Any authenticated user can extract other customers' private financial accounts by passing arbitrary account_id.
exploit_request:
POST /api/auth/token/?account_id=ACC-99481 HTTP/1.1
Host: billing.saas-platform.com
Content-Type: application/json
